title: 品格教育：感恩
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Gratitude 品格教育：感恩

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: the year a library on wheels came to your school
strip.zh: 一輛書車開進你們學校的那一年

strip.en: thank-you card from each of you

lines.en: I come from Huntington Beach, California.
lines.zh: 我來自加州的杭廷頓海灘。

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

slides.ask_en: Since you woke up today, who did something for you?
slides.ask_zh: 從今天起床到現在，有誰為你做了什麼？

slides.ask_en: I flew 13 hours to get here. Many people helped me on the way. Can you guess who?
slides.ask_zh: 我飛了 13 個小時才到這裡，一路上有很多人幫我。猜猜看是誰？

slides.body_en: Gratitude means noticing what other people do for you — and then saying thank you, or giving something back.
slides.body_zh: 感恩，就是注意到別人為你做了什麼——然後說聲謝謝，或是回饋一點什麼。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone made breakfast for you today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人幫你準備早餐的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone brought you to school today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人送你來學校的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you said thank you to them.
prompts.zh: 有跟他們說謝謝的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: So many people help us every day. We just don't always notice.
slides.punch_zh: 每天有好多人在幫我們，只是我們不一定注意到。

slides.q_en: Principal Huang came to Chingshan this year. His vision has three words: groundedness, growth, and…
slides.q_zh: 黃校長今年來到青山。他的辦學理念有三個詞：踏實、成長，還有……
slides.explain_en: Gratitude! Your principal brought this word to Chingshan. Today, it is our word, too.
slides.explain_zh: 感恩！這是校長帶來青山的詞。今天，它也是我們的關鍵字。

slides.head_zh: 青雲有路勤直上，山斗無峰謙自高
slides.ask_en: Your motto stone says: work hard to climb high, and stay humble. Humble people remember who helped them climb.
slides.ask_zh: 校訓石上寫著：認真往上爬，也要保持謙虛。謙虛的人，會記得是誰幫他爬上來的。

slides.q_en: In April 2025, a library on wheels came to Chingshan. When its sides opened, they looked like the wings of a…
slides.q_zh: 2025 年 4 月，一輛書車開進青山。車子兩側打開時，看起來像什麼的翅膀？
slides.explain_en: A seagull! Volunteers like “Uncle Seagull” drive the book truck to schools, so you can fly into the world of reading.
slides.explain_zh: 海鷗！「海鷗叔叔」這些志工把書車開到學校，讓你們乘著書本的翅膀飛向閱讀的世界。

slides.body_en: Your Parents' Association helps with the welcome party, sports day, Christmas, Children's Day — and the gifts for graduates. University students from National Chung Hsing University teach you online as your “big partners.” So many people are on your team.
slides.body_zh: 家長會幫忙辦迎新、運動會、聖誕節、兒童節，還有畢業生的禮物。中興大學的大哥哥大姐姐當你們的「大學伴」，在線上陪你們學習。好多人都站在你們這一邊。

slides.q_en: In 2024, the Chingshan recorder team entered the county music contest. How did their ensemble do?
slides.q_zh: 2024 年，青山直笛隊參加全縣音樂比賽。合奏的成績是？
slides.explain_en: First place! And the team said thank you to their teachers and their parents. Winners remember who helped them win.
slides.explain_zh: 第一名！直笛隊還特別感謝指導老師和家長。贏的人會記得是誰幫他們贏的。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: You only need to say thank you for big things.
items.zh: 只有大事才需要說謝謝。
items.note_en: Small things count too — like holding a door.
items.note_zh: 小事也算——像是幫你扶門。

items.en: Saying thank you can make YOU happier, too.
items.zh: 說謝謝也會讓自己更快樂。
items.note_en: Scientists have studied it: grateful people often feel happier.
items.note_zh: 科學家研究過：懂得感恩的人通常比較快樂。

items.note_en: Your parents and volunteers show it with actions. So can you.
items.note_zh: 家長和志工用行動表現。你也可以。

items.en: It's too late to thank someone from years ago.
items.zh: 好幾年前幫過你的人，現在謝已經太晚了。
items.note_en: Never too late! Your first-grade teacher would love to hear it.
items.note_zh: 永遠不嫌晚！你一年級的老師一定很想聽到。

items.zh: 我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

items.en: We couldn't do it without you.

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many helpers as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「幫助我們的人」越好，我來數！

slides.prompt_en: Before you graduate, who is one person at Chingshan you want to thank?
slides.prompt_zh: 畢業之前，在青山你最想感謝的一個人是誰？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.tip_en: Give it to them yourself — today!

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me: who will get YOUR card?
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我：你的卡片要送給誰？

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do Before You Graduate
slides.head_zh: 畢業前可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Say thank you to a helper — and use their name.
items.zh: 向一位幫助你的人說謝謝——叫出他的名字。

items.en: Give your card to the person you wrote it for.
items.zh: 把卡片親手交給你寫給的那個人。

items.en: Help a younger student. One day, YOU will be the one who gives back.
items.zh: 幫學弟妹一個忙。有一天，你也會是回饋母校的那個人。

slides.q_en: In America, there is a whole holiday just for saying thank you. When is it?
slides.q_zh: 在美國，有一個專門說謝謝的節日。是哪一天？
slides.explain_en: Thanksgiving! This year it is November 26. Families share a big dinner, and each person says one thing they are thankful for.
slides.explain_zh: 感恩節！今年是 11 月 26 日。全家人一起吃大餐，每個人說一件自己感謝的事。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Chingshan Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell Dom who you thanked today.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到青山國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴 Dom 你今天感謝了誰。

slides.big_zh: 謙虛向上，把謝謝說出口。
